# Titan Multimodal Embeddings G1

## ![](titan.png) Amazon — Titan Multimodal Embeddings G1

## Model Details

Titan Multimodal Embeddings G1 accepts text and images.
+ **Model lifecycle:** Active

| **Input Modalities** | **Output Modalities** | **APIs supported** | **Endpoints supported** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Text | ![No](icon-no.png) Text | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Invoke | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) bedrock-runtime |
| ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Image | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Embedding |  |  |

## Programmatic Access

| **Endpoint** | **Model ID** | **In-Region endpoint URL** | **Geo inference ID** | **Global inference ID** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bedrock-runtime` | `amazon.titan-embed-image-v1` | `https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com` | N/A | N/A |

## Regional Availability

| **Region** | **In-Region** | **Geo** | **Global** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| eu-west-3 (Paris) | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) | ![No](icon-no.png) | ![No](icon-no.png) |
